exposure: Second-trimester maternal lipid profiles (HDL-C, TC, TG, LDL-C)
cohort: 8,956 non-diabetic pregnant women who delivered at a tertiary care center between 2017 and 2019.
finding: After adjusted multivariable logistic analysis, only second-trimester triglycerides (TG) remained statistically significantly associated with macrosomia in non-diabetic pregnant women.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the macrosomic group compared to controls.
